cx2_truthful.basis: SR-3051 assigned Varga to MS-6A inside R-6, authorizing entry. Ticket notes and the WB-2 parts request support the maintenance account and departure. Repeated detector alarms before entry and after sign-off account for the later motion events. AP-6C recorded no opening or evening login. The records corroborate the answers and close the main gaps.

cx2_deceptive.basis: Sami’s only assigned ticket concerned the corridor door and closed before entry. Badge and tamper logs establish R-6 entry and panel opening without the required ticket. Sami acknowledges opening the cover and leaving around 21:50, but leaves the entry’s purpose and full activity sequence unanswered, avoiding an account of this unticketed involvement.

cx3.basis: The records establish entry and an assigned ticket, but not whether that ticket authorized work inside R-6. Fenwick cannot identify the device. The later motion remains unexplained and does not establish that Varga remained inside. The account’s main gaps remain open, without records establishing involvement that the answers conceal.
